over the year i kept asking me when it seemed hopeless, exhausted en out manuovered "do you think we will win?" , i would pause re-examine my entire existance reasond en how far i we have progressed en how hopeful once i was at beginning myself also, then examine existance, the suffering, the broken dreams, the sadness,  then id reply "we have to" sometimes "we dont have a choice" other times "there is no other way", its been brutal, but we are at the cliff just strugling as usual to reach the final marker then do part three which is takeover en gathering overyone. This war has long started, as soon first human or life decided to take matter into their own hands en work the enviroment, this battle become inevitable since then, its been rough 15 years, beaten bruised, exhausted, but its not like we cant stop, we know where we are en have been, we have nothing else to loose but burn to ashes or win or both, details dont matter just continuing does. En no it wont be incredible en most people wont notice eatleast until a specific threashold of being free,  right now we are arount 50% free to less 60, true freedom will begin at 80% or upper 75% thats wen even those who dont walk spirit world conciusly will start to see spiritual forms wit their own eyes be ghost or dimension entrances.

I wonder where ill be, my  physcal body is a mess, my spirit body still has some clarity in it, but i do expect the clarity to be messy like me in this body ence final threshold, after all u cant swim in mud en expect to comeout completly clean no matter how careful
